question: Droupadi Murmu was elected the _______ President of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**15th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Droupadi Murmu **

 
 
• **​Droupadi Murmu **was elected the **15****th** President of India.
 
• Since** July 25, 2022**, **Droupadi Murmu**, also known as **Puti Biranchi Tudu**, has held the office of India's **15th** president.
 
• She was born on** June 20, 1958**. After **Pratibha Patil**, she is the second woman to hold the position and the first member of a tribal community to do so.
 
• Along with being the first President born in** Independent India**, she is also the youngest person to hold the position. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **June 20, 1958**, **Droupadi Murmu** was born to a **Santali **family in the village of **Uparbeda** in the **Rairangpur**, **Odisha**, neighborhood of **Baidaposi**. **Biranchi Narayan Tudu**, her father, was a farmer.
 
• Her father and grandfather served as the local council's traditional leaders, or **Sarpanch **(Gram Panchayat).
 
• They gave her the name** Puti Tudu**.
 
• Her teacher changed her name from** Durpadi to Droupadi**, and she had previously gone by the names **Dorpdi **and **Durpadi**.
